---
title: "Influences"
---

What the lingua franca owes to each framework reviewed here: which framework's ideas, API shapes, meanings, or defaults the [best practices](../best-practices/README.md) and the [design](../design/00-overview.md) took up. It is a rough judgment, made by reading each area's best-practices document and design document against the reviews, not a count of mentions: a framework cited only as a counterexample, or for an approach that was rejected, gets nothing. **New** is what no framework did first; **Other** is frameworks without a review here, such as Covasim, MIRA, and PyRoss. Hover over a bar or a cell for what was taken.

## Overall

Each framework's share of the whole design, with each of the 17 areas below counted equally.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import sciris as sc
influences = sc.importbypath('influences.py')
print(influences.overall())
```

## By area

Each row adds to 100%. Starsim, as the base, supplies most of the agent-based architecture, the time types, and the random number streams, but little of the geospatial and stratification design, which comes mostly from epymorph, LASER, SimInf, and summer2.

::: {.column-page}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(influences.heatmap())
```
:::

The numbers are in [influences.yaml](https://github.com/starsimhub/lingua_franca_design/blob/main/approaches/influences.yaml), with a note on what was taken for each one.
